about: Eight parts in HuBMAP's file (3D Reference Organ for Brain, v1.4) wear each other's names, in a ring, the same on both sides. Found 15 Nov 2026 by fitting the model to the Allen label volume; see CWVault/claude/Report-Survey-Brain-Atlas-01.md. Key: the name in the file, without Allen_ and the side. Value: the part it really is. Apply as the model loads; the model file itself is never changed.
